notes.title: Earth 10 Days: 981Hz (Major Art Update)
notes.content:
Dear players,

As TinyBigger welcomes a new artist to the team, we’re also excited to announce the first major update for Earth 10 Days: 981Hz! The game’s visuals have been upgraded from a lower-resolution pixel art style to high-definition graphics. We’ve also fixed several small bugs found in the demo.
